visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a split-screen layout. At the bottom, a woman in a beige knit outfit and a man in a black t-shirt and glasses appear in a small overlay, observing a video above them. In the top video, a tall male and a female in a gray tracksuit are in a white-walled room with a plant. The woman in gray bends sideways against a doorframe, extending her arm downwards. (2) The scene transitions to a brightly lit modern indoor studio with a large silver metallic panel. The woman in the beige outfit leans against this panel, stretching her right arm vertically downward while bending her torso. The man in the black t-shirt stands beside her, watching her alignment and pointing at the top of the panel to mark her reach. (3) The woman stands up and reacts with an expressive open-mouthed smile, laughing and making dynamic hand gestures. Animated orange flames and large variety-style text overlays appear around her. The man points at her and laughs, maintaining a friendly facial expression. (4) The man in the black t-shirt then takes his turn leaning against the silver panel, attempting the same arm-stretch measurement. The woman watches him and places her hand above his head to compare his height to his reach. They both look towards the camera as a circular social media follow sticker appears over the man's chest.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a rapid, high-pitched female Mandarin narration describing an anatomical illusion. A high-tempo pop-electronic BGM with a strong percussive beat (124 BPM) plays simultaneously. A 'whoosh' transition sound marks the intro. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect occurs as the scene transitions. The female voice continues with a curious tone, followed by the male voice entering with a supportive, inquisitive quality. The BGM remains steady in the background. (3) A series of loud cartoonish impact sounds and comic 'boing' effects occur as the characters react to the measurement. The female voice breaks into high-energy laughter (arousal 8) while the male voice jokingly critiques her arm length. (4) The voices continue to overlap in a playful banter. More 'bell' and 'ui click' sound effects emphasize the variety-show style editing. The BGM maintains its energy until a final soft electronic chime signals the end of the video.
